\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 257-259 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R263-first-pass-words-from-chapters-257-259}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a fruit seller and a greengrocer.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item tears, a smile, affection, friendship, shame
  \item a screwdriver, a tool, a pipe, a tap, a shower
  \item a dish, a menu, tangy, fine white flour, semolina
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Tears? (\textbf{\ur{آنسو}}, \emph{ā̃sū}.) A smile? (\textbf{\ur{مسکراہٹ}}, \emph{muskurāhaṭ}.) Affection? (\textbf{\ur{محبت}}, \emph{mohabbat}.) Friendship? (\textbf{\ur{دوستی}}, \emph{dostī}.) Shame? (\textbf{\ur{شرم}}, \emph{sharm}.) A screwdriver? (\textbf{\ur{پیچ} \ur{کس}}, \emph{pechkas}.) A tool? (\textbf{\ur{اوزار}}, \emph{auzār}.) A pipe? (\textbf{\ur{پائپ}}, \emph{pāip}.) A tap? (\textbf{\ur{نل}}, \emph{nal}.) A shower? (\textbf{\ur{شاور}}, \emph{shāvar}.) A dish? (\textbf{\ur{پکوان}}, \emph{pakvān}.) A menu? (\textbf{\ur{مینیو}}, \emph{menyū}.) Tangy? (\textbf{\ur{چٹپٹا}}, \emph{chaṭpaṭā}.) Fine white flour? (\textbf{\ur{میدہ}}, \emph{maidā}.) Semolina? (\textbf{\ur{سوجی}}, \emph{sūjī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 260-263 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R263-second-pass-words-from-chapters-260-263}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a meatball and a tikka.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a meatball, a tikka, kadhi, a jalebi, a gulab jamun
  \item a company, a factory, a meeting, an officer, an owner
  \item a judge, a pupil, an engineer, a scientist, an actor
  \item a baker, a sweet-maker, a grocer, a fruit seller, a greengrocer
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A meatball? (\textbf{\ur{کوفتہ}}, \emph{koftā}.) A tikka? (\textbf{\ur{تکہ}}, \emph{tikkā}.) Kadhi? (\textbf{\ur{کڑھی}}, \emph{kaṛhī}.) A jalebi? (\textbf{\ur{جلیبی}}, \emph{jalebī}.) A gulab jamun? (\textbf{\ur{گلاب} \ur{جامن}}, \emph{gulāb jāmun}.) A company? (\textbf{\ur{کمپنی}}, \emph{kampanī}.) A factory? (\textbf{\ur{کارخانہ}}, \emph{kārkhānā}.) A meeting? (\textbf{\ur{میٹنگ}}, \emph{mīṭing}.) An officer? (\textbf{\ur{افسر}}, \emph{afsar}.) An owner? (\textbf{\ur{مالک}}, \emph{mālik}.) A judge? (\textbf{\ur{جج}}, \emph{jaj}.) A pupil? (\textbf{\ur{شاگرد}}, \emph{shāgird}.) An engineer? (\textbf{\ur{انجینئر}}, \emph{injīniyar}.) A scientist? (\textbf{\ur{سائنسدان}}, \emph{sāinsdān}.) An actor? (\textbf{\ur{اداکار}}, \emph{adākār}.) A baker? (\textbf{\ur{نانبائی}}, \emph{nānbāī}.) A sweet-maker? (\textbf{\ur{حلوائی}}, \emph{halvāī}.) A grocer? (\textbf{\ur{پنساری}}, \emph{pansārī}.) A fruit seller? (\textbf{\ur{پھل} \ur{والا}}, \emph{phalvālā}.) A greengrocer? (\textbf{\ur{سبزی} \ur{والا}}, \emph{sabzīvālā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
